description: Use only once the customer has decided to buy ("I'll take it", "how do I buy?"): the checkout handoff for one choice (same input as quote_esim). Returns the buy_url to give the customer, the final price and a ready-to-send checkout block (next_step, payment_methods, delivery) — the shop page opens preset to exactly this data size; the customer presses the buy button (buy_button in the result, e.g. "Get your eSIM" in English) and pays securely. No account needed; the eSIM is delivered on screen and by e-mail right after payment. No in-chat order tracking, no discount codes. For prices while the customer is still comparing, use quote_esim.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

gb.description: The data pool in GB, ONE pool for every included country, valid 90 days: 3, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100. Omit = 10 GB. Not sure? Call recommend_config.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, it. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

name: start_checkout

buy_button.description: The label of the buy button on the page, in the language of the customer: name it exactly so.

buy_url.description: The shop page preset to exactly this data size. Use verbatim.

coverage.description: The coverage: Europe (zone eu) and its number of countries.

data_gb.description: ONE data pool for every included country (not per day, not per country).

data_only.description: true: no phone number, no SMS.

delivery.description: How and when the eSIM arrives.

message.description: A ready-to-send line for the customer.

next_step.description: What the customer does now: open buy_url, press "Get your eSIM", pay.

note.description: Present when something about the request had to be adjusted — read it to the customer.

price.description: FULL price of exactly this choice in currency — the amount paid. Not per GB, per day or per country.

topup.description: How the customer recharges later (a new 90-day pack of 3, 10 or 20 GB on the same eSIM), with the server recharge prices when available.

validity.description: "90 days from the first connection to a network" — say it this way.

validity_starts.description: The days start at the first connection to a network, not at purchase or installation.

title: Start secure checkout
